ECN (Netherlands) Aspen Plus study of membrane-distillation hybrids for (a) the ethylene/ethane C2 splitter and (b) BASF-NMP butadiene extraction. Main file: butadiene extraction base case and seven membrane options (Table 3; 100 kt/yr butadiene): final steam and electricity per t butadiene DERIVED from the printed specific primary energy, the printed primary coefficients (steam 1.05, electricity 2.33) and the printed MW split (implied ~7,670 h/yr for every case, a consistency check); capex = printed membrane area x printed 1600 EUR/m2 installed module cost (module only, incremental). Also the vendor TCI of a 500 kt/yr ethylene plant (Table 2, reprinted from Towler and Sinnott 2008), per t ethylene. Measures: primary-energy saving per option (derived), C2-splitter selectivity thresholds and debottlenecking payback, and literature claims (reprinted).
